lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: Tomorrow is the last day of the campaign period. After today, Mahinda Bandara no longer gives interviews.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: Do you have your NIC? You will need it at the polling station. Your polling station is Rivisanda Maha Vidyalaya. Queue from 7am. I would not recommend 7am.

lines.prompt: Is there anything else you want to look at?
